h1: Executive Chauffeur Service Miami — Hourly & As-Directed | Onyx Executive Miami
a1: Hourly and as-directed executive chauffeur service in Miami and South Florida. Meetings, roadshows, multi-stop days, and evenings — one chauffeur, your schedule.
l6: Is there a minimum booking length?
l7: Yes — minimum hours are confirmed with your quote, based on your date and itinerary. There's no single published number because it varies by day and demand.
l8: What if I need extra time beyond what I booked?
l9: Additional time is billed by the hour at the same rate, subject to the chauffeur's availability for the rest of the day — confirm in advance if there's a chance you'll run long.
l10: Can I add stops that weren't in the original plan?
l11: Yes, within the hours you've booked. Extra stops don't require a new booking — just tell your chauffeur.
l13: The chauffeur follows your instructions in real time rather than a fixed route — wait here, go there next, change plans mid-afternoon. You're not locked into an itinerary set at booking.
l15: Tolls are included in the quoted rate. Parking or valet fees at a specific venue, if any, are confirmed case by case.
l16: What happens during standby or a meal break?
l17: Standby time — waiting while you're in a meeting or at dinner — is part of the hours you've booked. Your chauffeur takes a meal break during long standby periods without leaving you without coverage; this is coordinated so it never falls during an active pickup.
l18: Is there room for luggage or shopping bags between stops?
l19: Yes — capacity is confirmed at booking based on what you're bringing, common for shopping trips or a day that starts or ends at the airport.
l20: Can I extend on the day, once we're already out?
l21: Usually, yes, but it's subject to availability — if the chauffeur has another booking after yours, an extension may not be possible. Flagging a likely extension in advance avoids that.
